text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1926/48 – THURSDAY, AUGUST 06, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (Chapter 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.:ෙදො/ඉ/1/අත්/112. Reference No.: 4/3/6/2012/HW/229.

I hereby give notice, under sub section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following lands / servitude* which is required for a public purpose

Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: Lot No. 1 to 8 allotments below name land in total extent of about 0.1723, shown in Preliminary Plan No. Ka. 4522 and dated 17.04.2015, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kaluthara District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Thebuwana in the Grama Niladari Division of No. 809 Thebuwana-East in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dodangoda, in the District of Kaluthara in Western Province.
01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Kohilawatta Kumbura; Description: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Cannot be found ; Extent: 0.0582 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Kohilawatta Kumbura; Description: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: —; Extent: 0.0109 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Kohilawatta Kumbura; Description: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Cannot be found; Extent: 0.0636 Hectare.
04. Lot No. 4 Name of the Land: Araliyagahawatta; Description: Garden, contains a part of Temporary Building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: P. D. Jayasiri of Themuwana; Extent: 0.0052 Hectare.
05. Lot No. 5 Name of the Land: Araliyagahawatta; Description: Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: M. H. Dasanayake of Thebuwana; Extent: 0.0016 Hectare.
06. Lot No. 6 Name of the Land: Araliyagahawatta; Description: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: —; Extent: 0.0003 Hectare.
07. Lot No. 7 Name of the Land: Araliyagahawatta; Description: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: —; Extent: 0.0185 Hectare.

08. Lot No. 8 Name of the Land: Araliyagahawatta; Description: Garden, contains a part of Permanent Building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Helabage Seelawathi of Thebuwana; Extent: 0.0140 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid land / lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing,
